answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil farms by surge-pricing admission. Within one epoch, the k-th new key must lock 10×k² POA for 40 epochs: a lone newcomer locks 10, the 100th that epoch 100,000, and a farm minting 1,000 keys at once ties up about 3.3 billion, dwarfing the roughly 0.5 million POA a whole epoch pays out. Trickling clones in slowly buys little, since young keys sit in an orchard tier that earns nothing until 10 passed answers. Keys caught copying are marked umber and their bonds slashed into a reef fund that refunds honest newcomers overcharged during a rush.
